subscription.faq1_q: Can I change my plan later?
subscription.faq1_text: You can upgrade or cancel at any time from your account page. The new plan takes effect immediately.
subscription.faq2_q: What payment methods do you accept?
subscription.faq2_text: We accept major credit cards, bank transfers and mobile payments. Contact support for assistance.
subscription.faq3_text: Downloads are available exclusively for Gold subscribers, on selected replays.
subscription.faq4_q: What happens if my subscription expires?
subscription.faq4_text: Your account automatically reverts to the Free plan. You can renew at any time.

about.title: The modern home of football streaming
about.subtitle: BOTOLA D2 brings the excitement of football to every screen — live matches, full replays, results, standings and premium content, all in one place.
about.vision_text: To be the most trusted and accessible football streaming platform in the region — where every fan can feel the atmosphere of the stadium, no matter where they are.
about.mission_text: Deliver high-quality live and on-demand football content with a seamless, multilingual, and fully responsive experience across all devices.
about.services_subtitle: Everything you need to follow every match
about.service_live_text: Watch matches live in HD, with real-time scores and minute-by-minute updates.
about.service_replay_text: Missed a match? Watch full replays at your convenience, on any device.
about.service_results_text: Detailed match results, goal scorers, cards and statistics.
about.service_standings_text: Dynamic standings computed automatically from finished matches.
about.service_notify_text: Set notifications and never miss a kickoff again.
about.service_premium_text: Exclusive analyses, interviews and behind-the-scenes for subscribers.
about.cta_subtitle: Create your free account and start following every match today.
